Cyware is hiring a Senior Software Engineer (reporting to the Senior VP of Engineering) to build and harden its AI-enabled Cyber Fusion cybersecurity platform for both commercial enterprise and public-sector customers. The work centers on developing scalable, compliant features that meet FedRAMP/GovRAMP controls — secure coding, audit logging, RBAC, and encryption in transit and at rest — and shipping them through CI/CD into commercial and AWS GovCloud environments. The core stack is Python with Django/Django REST Framework for REST APIs, microservices with gRPC, generative-AI integrations such as LLM services and RAG pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes, AWS, and data infrastructure spanning PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, Kafka, and RabbitMQ.
